human_review_text: The paper presents an algorithm to learn sparse intermediate representations through constraining activations to be sparse. The proposed algorithm relies on a combination of a ``Spatial Sparsity layer'' and ``adaptive sparse training". The spatial sparsity layer leverages a parametric form of ReLU to control sparsity. The adaptive sparse training anneals the sparsity parameter to encourage learning. The algorithm is evaluated on motif prediction and localization on three datasets.
